reference: Guo et al., Phys. Lett. B 807, 135572 (2020)

summary.mechanism_conflict: Guo 2020 explicitly refutes the identical-configuration MchiD mechanism used in 103Rh, invoking pseudospin mixing between pi(g7/2) and pi(d5/2) to explain the four positive-parity bands (D3-D6).
summary.lifetime_absence: No DSAM or RDDS lifetimes exist for Bands D3-D8; absolute B(E2), B(M1), and B(E1) strengths are completely unmeasured.
summary.methodological_boundary: In multi-band manifolds (four same-parity bands), level energies and branching ratios cannot uniquely determine whether the system is an identical-configuration MchiD, a pseudospin-chiral quartet, or triaxial vibrational states without absolute transition rates.
